worldcombat.skill.burnup.summary: Draw every flame in the body inward, then vent a cone of white fire in front: the target squarely in it takes full damage, others in the cone take the side flame. Afterwards the user is truly burned out — for a while it is no longer Fire type and cannot light another Burn Up.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.description.0: The white fire's core damage %1$s; ×1.12 more while the user is Fire type (it is burning its own typing).
worldcombat.skill.burnup.description.1: The white fire reaches %1$s blocks and opens a %2$s degree cone, its front rushing out at %3$s blocks per tick; targets not squarely in it take %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.description.2: Afterwards the user is burned out for %1$s, losing its Fire type and unable to cast again; the burst throws %2$s embers.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.use.0: Scorch a cone with one blast
worldcombat.skill.burnup.use.1: Trade the Fire typing for one heavy hit
worldcombat.skill.burnup.preference.bank: On: burnout ×0.7 and 4 ticks less cooldown (regain the Fire typing sooner), but this hit is ×0.9. Off: burns longer with a longer cooldown, this hit is ×1.1.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.preference.ai.m: Beyond this distance the user closes in before kindling. Higher opens from further out.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.preference.ai.h: A target below this health ratio moves Burn Up to the front (saved for a finish). Higher spends it sooner.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.timing: Range %1$s blocks; kindle %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.growth.0: From level %1$s: Burn Up power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.growth.1: From level %1$s: Burn Up power %2$s, burst distance %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.banked.on: Banked: some fire is kept, burnout and cooldown are shorter, this hit is held back.
worldcombat.skill.burnup.banked.off: All-out: burn it all, this hit hits for full, at the cost of a longer burnout and cooldown.
